name: ReplyHey
summary: Finds people asking for what you sell on Reddit, X and LinkedIn, drafts replies from your accounts, and traces those replies toward revenue.
description: Finds people asking for what you sell on Reddit, X and LinkedIn, drafts replies from your accounts, and traces those replies toward revenue.

pricing.details: Starter 32 €/month — 1 website, 1 AI agent, Reddit leads only, Reddit checked twice a day. Base 45 €/month — up to 3 websites, 2 AI agents, Reddit, X and LinkedIn leads, up to 10 email leads a day. Pro 90 €/month — 6 websites, 2 AI agents, Reddit checked 4 times a day, up to 20 email leads a day, CRM, keyword monitoring, brand sentiment, daily brand mentions. Official 2 days free on Starter, Base or Pro, cancel any time. No lasting free plan was stated.
